limitations: Only decorative raised stage/edge render boxes are removed and their existing materials partition the original Floor_0 plane. Exact chairs, fitted support, actor/wire anchors, physical colliders, approaches and F3 navigation are held. Fresh bake, populated stage contact and room art review required. No motion profile, connected authority, voice or registry assignment.

floor_partition.seam_method: Convex half-plane partition of each original triangle; intersection coordinates pinned to the exact shared X/Z boundary; all original planeY/UV/normal interpolation retained. Brass and walnut regions are disjoint; no second coplanar surface or height overlay is created.
